set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set protocols bgp group external-peers t.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers type external
set protocols bgp group external-peers t.explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of BGP group, e.g. external.

set protocols bgp group external-peers l.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers local-address 192.168.2.1
set protocols bgp group external-peers l.explanation: Configure the local address of the BGP group.

parameters.name: local-address
parameters.explanation: Local address of the BGP group.

set protocols bgp group external-peers p.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group external-peers p.explanation: Configure the BGP group's equivalent AS.

set protocols bgp group external-peers n.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers neighbor 192.168.2.2
set protocols bgp group external-peers n.explanation: Configure the neighbors of the BGP team.

set routing-options router-id 5.5.5.5.explanation: Configures the id of the router.

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: Router ID for the identification of router in protocols such as BGP.
